from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def nmse(p): return np.mean((p-dA_dt)**2)/np.var(dA_dt)
def fit(f,n,starts=12,seed=2):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); best=None
    for s in range(starts):
        p0=rng.uniform(-1.5,1.5,n)
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(p)-dA_dt,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6), p0, max_nfev=1500)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    return best
F={}
F['mm']=(lambda p: -p[0]*t**p[1]*A/(p[2]+A)+p[3]*A**p[4]*t**p[5],6)
F['mm2']=(lambda p: -p[0]*t**p[1]*A**p[2]/(1+p[3]*A)+p[4]*A**p[5]*t**p[6],7)
F['mm3']=(lambda p: -p[0]*t**p[1]*A**p[2]/(1+p[3]*A)+p[4]*A**p[5]*t**p[6]*np.exp(-p[7]*t),8)

F['mm5']=(lambda p: -p[0]*t**p[1]*A**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*A)+p[4]*A**p[5]*t**p[6]/(1+p[7]*A),8)
out=[]
for k,(f,n) in F.items():
    b=fit(f,n)
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'): pr=f(b.x)
